### Predictor recall for batched targets (new metric, E2 step 4)

> **Read `lift_over_random_batched`, not raw recall, when comparing across batch sizes.** The candidate pool (pred_union) grows mechanically with B since each of the B requests contributes its own top-m set, so raw recall rises with batch even with zero predictive skill. `baseline_random_batched` is the batch-scaled chance floor (analogous to the pilot's `baseline_random = m/n_experts`); `lift_over_random_batched = recall_overall - baseline` is what the predictor is actually contributing.
